name: bridge-contract-tests
description: Static type-check of the shipped tiro-swm-bridge.js against the @tiro-health/web-sdk (<tiro-form-filler>) frontend contract. The SDK is intentionally NOT a dependency here: CI installs the version pinned in build/web-sdk/package.json — the bundle the harness embeds and serves (GH-24) — so the check validates the pairing that actually ships. A second, non-blocking nightly job checks @latest as a drift alarm.
